notes.title: News from the Depths: Progress, Events, and More
notes.content:
Demo Status

As you already know, we have been working on preparing a demo for players to try out. The purpose of this demo is twofold. On the one hand, we want to showcase what Choose Cthulhu Files has to offer players, and on the other hand, we want to gather player feedback on the game. This feedback is crucial to ensuring that Choose Cthulhu Files meets expectations.

So, first, we wanted to announce that we expect to have a playable demo ready by the end of May 2025, and secondly, we wanted to share the current state of the demo.

We have already designed all the characters needed for this first demo, as well as all the scenes for the game's intro and the demo portion of one of the storylines included for you to try out.

Additionally, we have been working on multiple internal aspects of the game to fix bugs and improve the overall experience while playing. Right now, we are in the "assembly" phase of the scenes and conducting internal playtesting.

We are eager to complete it so you can try it as soon as possible.

Indie Games Show

We also wanted to mention that this year we will be participating in several events where you can get to know us better and where we will showcase some of the work we have been doing with Choose Cthulhu Files.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45266872/d14f0b8a556d2b4d7c8d7eeb629c2018b569e351.jpg

We will be participating remotely in the Indie Games Show in Málaga, where we will talk about our experience developing an indie game and showcase some live gameplay of Choose Cthulhu Files.

El Rincón Jam

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45266872/9a99de4f491cd27ed2948cf02fdcabc7e236da2f.jpg

We will also be attending, physically this time, the Jam El Rincón 2025 in Gran Canaria, where we will give a talk about indie development and be available throughout the event to chat with anyone interested in Choose Cthulhu Files, game development, Cthulhu, Lovecraft, and whatever else comes up.

Still Hard at Work

And that's all for now. Or maybe not... We are preparing for an event that we will reveal in due time, where you will be able to play Choose Cthulhu Files if you drop by. We will share more details as soon as possible.

Don't forget to add Choose Cthulhu Files to your wishlist, sign up for our newsletter, and follow us on social media.

Now we really say goodbye. Thank you, as always, for supporting us and being there.

See you next time!

notes.title: Development status November 2024
notes.content:
We have been developing Choose Cthulhu Files for some time now, but until now, the devlogs we have been publishing have mainly focused on the preliminary analysis, creative processes, and work processes that we are following, etc.

From now on, the following devlogs will have a different structure in which we will explain the different advances we have made in development. In some cases, we will delve a little deeper to explain some particularly interesting aspect of the development, but if you think there is something that interests you and we have not talked about, let us know and we will consider the possibility of making an article explaining it.

Everything is clarified, so let's get started with the devlog!

ENGINE DEVELOPMENT

As of today, we have developed a base engine that implements all the basic functions for the development of a visual novel and hundreds of small details related to the player's experience when playing. Some of the features already implemented are:


 Set the current scene with its graphics and objects
 Show and hide characters
 Show story text
 Advance the text quickly
 Show various dialogue options to the player to continue the story


We have also implemented an exploration system that allows players to inspect scenes in the style of "point-and-click" graphic adventures. In exploration mode, the player can interact with various objects in the environment and examine them in detail to gather information and clues so they can use those discoveries to make decisions during the course of the story, or unlock options that were not available before.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45266872/186195bba72e7bbb0687f603e5211fc4281a0804.gif

CHARACTERS

In the characters section, we are already putting the finishing touches on the creation of the graphic assets of the characters that will appear in the game demo.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45266872/306de99cce808da095e366cf1ac7afbcb1f2e8fd.gif

In future devlogs and publications of our newsletter and social networks, we will provide information about them, so we recommend that if you do not want to miss them, follow us on Steam, social media and sign up for our newsletter.

SCENARIOS
Regarding the scenarios, we already have more than 50% of the scenarios necessary to complete the material required for the demo. Here you can see some scenes we are working on.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45266872/440856b7843a26adc5decdb402ace918987051f2.jpg

In the case of scenarios, we need to define the point of view of the scene and then create the environment and fill it with the different elements that make up the scene. Some elements require special definition and preparation, as they will be objects with which the player can interact, will be part of background animations, or as part of special effects for different events.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45266872/62d63ced2566330f952d7aa079fcde9c37046bb1.jpg

Next, we will lay out the elements to have the appropriate formats and sizes and then implement the scene by combining all the elements and implementing effects and interactions in the engine.

And that's all for now. We will continue to publish updates as we progress in development.

notes.title: Thank you for your support!
notes.content:
This is our first post on Steam. First and foremost, we wanted to thank you for all the support you’re giving us. It makes us very happy and motivates us to keep pushing forward with the project every day.

We want this project to be a success, but to make that happen, we need your help to let the whole world know about Choose Cthulhu Files.

There are many ways you can help us:


 Send fan art: about the game or Lovecraftian themes in general. We love seeing fan creations inspired by Lovecraft and art in general.
 Engage with us and other fans of Choose Cthulhu Files on the Steam forum or in our Discord.
 Follow us on our social media: It helps a lot when you share our posts, spreading the word about the game to more people.
We’ll be posting more updates soon with announcements about the game’s development.

Once again, thank you so much, and we’ll see you in the next post!
